Welcome back colleagues,
After departure changed little, but water breaks stayed in focus

Please stay alert on all Companion Animal Travel Desk cases and keep the handoff notes tight.<<FACT F085>> If anything looks off in the booking file, flag it at once and do not wait for the next cycle.

We are also tightening boarding coordination so no animal is left in a gap between checks and cabin handoff.<<FACT F099>> Keep carriers secure, confirm comfort items are present, and report any stress signs without delay. Safety is still the priority for every Aurelia Skyways journey, and calm handling matters as much as speed. I need every update clear, brief, and passed on without hesitation.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
